FULL TEXT:
DIRECTORATE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY & SUPPORT SYSTEM
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, Kashmir, J&K (India)
Advertisement Notice
Online Application Forms on the prescribed format, available on the Directorate of IT&SS website:
https://itss.uok.edu.in OR through the QR Code given below, are invited from the eligible candidates for
engagement as Software Tester, on a contractual basis, for the duration of one year (purely extendable based
on performance and requirements) in the Directorate of IT & SS, University of Kashmir. The online
application forms along with copies of qualification certificates and other necessary testimonials shall have
to be submitted by or before 21st June 2026. No hard copy (printout) thereof is required to be submitted, nor
shall it be entertained. Essential and desirable qualifications, emoluments, and other details of the positions
are summarised as under:

DIRECTORATE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY & SUPPORT SYSTEM
UNIVERSITY OF KASHMIR
Hazratbal, Srinagar-190006, Kashmir, J&K (India)
Other Terms and Conditions
1. The applicant must possess Domicile Certificate issued by the Competent Authority on
the format prescribed for the purpose, on or before the last date of submission of
application form.
2. The applicant should not be above 40 years of age as on 01.01.2026.
3. The applicants who have obtained degree from the Foreign University should upload
equivalence certificate issued by the AIU, New Delhi, without which their candidature
will not be considered and application form will be rejected.
4. Candidates should satisfy themselves about the job responsibilities requirements before
appearing in the Interview.
5. Any applicant found guilty of impersonation or submitting fabricated, tampered, fake, or
forged documents may be debarred permanently or for a specific period from being
considered for any future appointment, in addition to rendering him/her for criminal
proceedings under rules.
6. Application Form found incomplete in any respect shall be rejected without any notice.
7. In the event of a large number of applications being received, a written test shall be
conducted for shortlisting candidates for interview, in the ratio of 1:10 against the number
of advertised posts, the syllabus of which shall be notified separately.
8. No TA/DA shall be paid for attending the Written Test/Interview.
9. No claim, whatsoever, from the contractual engagee/s for their permanent absorption is
maintainable under rules and shall not be entertained at any stage.
10. The information regarding the screened-in/short-listed candidates and the schedule of
interview of the eligible candidates shall be notified separately.
11. The above positions are to be filled on short-term contractual basis for a period of 1 year
and may be extended further on the basis of performance and requirement.
12. Candidates should provide two references with contact number and email ID for
verification of professional experience.
13. The University reserves the right not to fill up the advertised post or cancel the interview,
if the circumstances warrant so.
No. F(Manpower/Tester)ITSS/26 Sd/-
Dated: 11-06-2026 Director IT & SS
